title: studio.page.version_copied.v1
description: A studio owner or admin replaced the draft of a builder page with a published version (synthwerk#108). Nothing went live. CloudEvents subject: the page id. The orgid extension and data.org_id hold the identity org id. actor: user:<sub>. No page content.

slug.description: URL slug of the page. Never free text.

version.description: The published version copied into the draft.
